pages.text: Tier D+. 4 iron ingots + 4 Mystery Ingots + a diamond.
Tier C+. 4 Mystery Ingots + 4 netherite ingots + Mystery Chestplate. Water breathing, immune to fire.
Tier B+. 2 wither skeleton skulls + 4 netherite ingots + 2 nether stars + Spirit Source Chestplate. Jump Boost, Night Vision, Haste, Strength III; immune to fire and wither. Unbreakable.
Tier A+. Dragon Soul + 4 end crystals + nether star + dragon head + elytra + Dark Source Chestplate. +100 max health, flight, cleanses harmful effects; also immune to dragon breath and projectiles.
Tier S+. 4 Heavenly Dao Fragments + 2 nether stars + Origin Dragon Chestplate. +200 max health; spends Mystery Energy to fully block any other damage.
